prerequisites: fetch and compare origin/main before P13
reuse the frozen organization API allowlist and single Node Event stream
preserve Control/Runtime database authority and Redis wake-only semantics
authorityBoundary: Control PostgreSQL owns Profile revisions, command receipts, Operation/Audit and the organization event stream. Runtime PostgreSQL owns Task, Capability readiness and binding facts; Control copies only bounded hint envelopes through a durable cursor. Organization clients refetch authoritative GET resources. P13 may harden security/recovery/operations/upgrade but may not add organization hierarchy, multi-node orchestration or a Console BFF.
